sloka: महावीर्यस्य दक्षस्य संयुगेष्वपलायिनः ।यातुधानस्य दौहित्र किं च मां नाभ्युदीक्षसे ।। ६.११४.८१ ।।
transliteration: mahāvīryasya dakṣasya saṁyugeṣvapalāyinaḥ ।yātudhānasya dauhitra kiṁ ca māṁ nābhyudīkṣase ।। 6.114.81 ।।

translations.english: "Resembling a dark cloud clad in yellow silk, why are you lying like this with limbs thrown down and body covered with blood?"
